task: EXP-M4-13 R7 DESYNC-ROOT CLOSURE. Per-file FIRST-desync-root census over the full 1024-file OWN-MSL corpus; for each unclean program the first offset where instr_length==None. Classify each byte0 root GENUINE-fixable vs pure cascade / operand-tail owned by an upstream op. Close the single biggest genuine root by byte-diff of own-MSL so the stream re-aligns and the downstream cascade collapses. CLEAN-ROOM: only shaders WE compile from OUR OWN MSL; shdump compile-only, no GPU dispatch; every closed op reproduced byte-exact from a fresh own-MSL compile.
kind: length_only + desync-closed (length-rule EDIT extends an EXISTING typed descriptor; no new descriptor, no field weakened)

baseline.method: census_roots.py walk() (align-forward resync tokenizer, same as EXP-M4-01 census.py) run over EXP-M4-13-full-corpus/hex/*.hex; FIRST-desync root = first walk record with status=='undecoded'.

0x00.note: `00 04 00 00` (x13) = interior of the vertex 0x17 coord-transform bundle (owner = 0x21 root); `00 02 e7 ..` = half2 saturate/neg tail before device_store; `00 10 11 00` = f16 subgroup epilogue. byte+1 sets {02,08,10} are operand-tail landings of the immediately-preceding op's family, not standalone leaders.

0x42.note: `42 XX 00 00 ZZ WW` (byte+2==0 AND byte+3==0). Upstream mov_imm is CORRECTLY lengthed (2B), so 0x42 is a genuine instruction leader missing a length rule -- NOT an operand-tail landing. It is the dst>=r4 sibling of the already-lengthed+named r0 form `02 XX 00`.

0x02.note: `02 c2 59 87` / `02 0a 59 15` etc = operand tails of preceding falu/coord ops; low-nibble-2 dst-r0 compact forms already handled where genuine.

0x21.verdict: GENUINE vertex-coord ops, resync-clean (NOT fixed -- needs own-MSL length per op)
0x21.note: `21 82 a6 b0 07 02 82 01` (8B) is a genuine low-nibble-1 op in the VERTEX coordinate-transform bundle, bracketed between the named vtx_coord_xform (0x17, 10B) and n2_op6; `07 02 a2 b0` (4B) likewise. These already resync cleanly (no cascade / no silent-mislength risk) so closing them is safe but requires byte-diff to length each op in the coord bundle -- deferred (vertex-coord family task).

0x54.verdict: GENUINE CASCADE but UNSAFE to force this round (needs-splice)
0x54.note: Root cause = an upstream low-nibble-2 SELECT op (reg-operand cmpsel `-> 10`, or the 0x22 `-> 10`, or a length_only 0x17) that over-reads by 2 and SWALLOWS a following op-leader (`0f 05` if_push / `0f 01` jump_cond / `9f 00` imad), exposing `54 XX` as spurious. Shortening those to 8 collapses the cascade -- BUT the follower byte is AMBIGUOUS: `9f 00` occurs at bytes+8..+9 of 4 GENUINE len-10 cmpsel sites too (probe_cmpsel8.py). A follower-byte heuristic would introduce SILENT mis-lengths that self-heal downstream and are invisible to the leftover metric. Correctly splitting 8-vs-10 needs own-MSL byte-diff per upstream family. Left UNRESOLVED honestly rather than gamed. (The r4 `e7/67 00`->8 gate is safe precisely because e7/67 never appears at +8 of a genuine cmpsel.)

0x44.verdict: NOT cascade -- independent RT-traversal ops (NOT fixed)
0x44.note: `44 21` (2B) is a genuine small op before sr_read_wide, but the 6102B downstream is MANY independent unmodeled RT-traversal ops scattered through the query body (fulldump.py rt_frag_query: 40+ separate regions), NOT a cascade from `44 21`. Fully decoding the traversal record is RT-traversal-record-layout territory (clean-room rule 5, forbidden as a transcribed sequence). Owner = the RT-traversal family; downstream desync is genuine-gap, not collapsible by closing `44 21`.

descriptors.semantics: Compact 6-byte low-nibble-2 select/predicate/helper (existing descriptor, UNCHANGED). The RT intersection_query / traversal GETTER-MARSHALLING op `Xn YY 00 00 ZZ WW` is the opsel==0x00 (compact_select/move) sub-form of this op: dst = byte0 high nibble; src_desc (byte+1) = the getter/state selector (0x00 dominant, also 0x3c/0x7e/0x08 observed); byte+2 (opsel) == 0x00 = compact select/move; byte+3 (opA) == 0x00 here (the length-gate invariant); byte+4/byte+5 = operand/immediate (usually 0, byte+5 can be nonzero e.g. `42 7e 00 00 00 0c`). Round-trips byte-exact (asm(disasm(b))==b) for dst r4/r6/r8/r9/r10/r12/r14 forms.
descriptors.provenance: CLEAN-ROOM OWN-MSL. shdump_r7_desync (compile-only, no GPU dispatch) built from tools/shdump/shdump.m; MSL WE wrote (corpus/dec2_n8_eight/g_bary.metal, g_geom.metal, g_commit.metal, g_inst.metal -- intersection_query getters) recompiled and confirmed byte-IDENTICAL to the committed corpus hex. Op boundary bracket-proven in own-MSL g_bary: mov_imm(2B) @342 -> `42 3c 00 00 00 00`(6B) @344 -> mov_imm @350; and `42 7e 00 00 00 0c` @352 -> scoreboard_fence(0x07) @358, so byte+5==0x0c is an OPERAND consumed by the op (proves 6B, not 2B+pads). dst=high-nibble confirmed by the reg-sweep already in n2_op6 (r0..r15) and by the observed dst set r4/r6/r8/r9/r10/r12/r14. No Apple binary was introspected.

lengthRuleEdits.location: isadb.instr_length, low-nibble-2 block, at the END -- immediately after the `if b0 == 0x32: return 6 if 0 <= b2 <= 0x3f else LEN_UNKNOWN` line, BEFORE the final `return LEN_UNKNOWN`.
lengthRuleEdits.gate: (b0 & 0x0f) == 0x02 and (already past the 0x02/0x12/0x22/0x32 returns, i.e. dst>=r4) and b2 == 0x00 and b3 == 0x00 and off + 5 < len(buf)
lengthRuleEdits.code:
if b2 == 0x00 and b3 == 0x00 and off + 5 < len(buf):
    return 6                   # getter_marshal / n2_op6 dst>=r4 (EXP-M4-13 R7)
lengthRuleEdits.change: ADD: length 6 for the dst>=r4 low-nibble-2 compact op with byte+2==0 AND byte+3==0. Reaches this fallback ONLY for dst>=r4 (0x02/0x12/0x22/0x32 return earlier), where instr_length previously returned LEN_UNKNOWN -- so PURELY ADDITIVE. It is the exact dst>=r4 analogue of the existing `if b0==0x02: if 0<=b2<=0x3f: return 6` rule (dst r0). The now-lengthed bytes decode as the existing n2_op6 descriptor (named, typed).
lengthRuleEdits.safety: Gate is LOAD-BEARING and MINIMAL: the b3==0x00 requirement is required -- dropping it (b2==0 only) regresses 6 tessellation vertex files (b3!=0 forms are genuinely 8/10B); broadening to any b2<=0x3f regresses 13 files. With b2==0 AND b3==0: 44 files improved, 0 files worse (no per-file leftover increase anywhere), roundtrip suite ALL PASS, 1024/1024 corpus files disassemble with 0 exceptions. 346 ops now length+named across 44 files.

rawBitsAccounting: 346 closed ops x 48 bits = 16608 bits were entirely UNLOCATED before (length unknown, no field typing). After: each op is length+named as n2_op6 with 28 bits located+typed (dst 4b, src_desc 8b, opsel 8b, imm_sel 8b) and 16 bits (opA byte+3, opB byte+4) kept RAW per n2_op6's EXISTING deliberate-raw policy -> 346 x 16 = 5536 bits still raw. In the getter_marshal sub-form opA(byte+3)==0x00 is the fixed length-gate invariant; opB(byte+4) is the operand descriptor whose value-semantics need a splice to map (unchanged from n2_op6's standing policy).
